g.text: Fig 5. Conceptual Synthesis: The Evolutionary Cost of "Evergreen" vs. "Resurrection"
Divergent adaptive trajectories and genomic trade-offs in Neotropical campos rupestres (OCBIL) under 9.68 Myr of divergence
UV-B >2000 µmol · Oligotrophic Sand · VPD >3.5 kPa
HABITAT: Bare Monolithic Quartzite Outcrops · Soil-less Saxicole · Dry-Season Ψleaf < -100 MPa
Targeted chlorophyll degradation prevents ROS formation in bare-rock sun.
Accumulation of LEA proteins & raffinose oligosaccharides (RFOs).
Quiescent state; complete stomatal closure; zero hydraulic cavitation risk.
2. GENOMIC ARCHITECTURE: REPAIR EXPANSIONS & POSITIVE SELECTION
CAFE5 TURNOVER (λ = 0.0036): 56 Stringent Expansions + 11 Rate-Sensitive Expansions
Preprotein translocons for massive chloroplast reassembly.
NADH:plastoquinone oxidoreductase for cyclic electron flow.
PsbA / PsbD reaction center repair enzymes.
De novo thylakoid lipid synthesis upon rehydration.
ORGANELIAR RNA EDITING & CHAPERONES UNDER DIVERSIFYING SELECTION (Ka/Ks > 1.0)
DYW cytidine deaminase (OG0011950, ω = 3.80), Organellar RRM (OG0012126, ω = 4.50)
DnaJ/Hsp40 co-chaperone (OG0011532, ω = 3.86), Transmembrane thioredoxin (OG0011290, ω = 4.31)
✔ Zero Drought Mortality: Survives total tissue
✖ Restricted Carbon Gain: Lower annual Amax
due to prolonged seasonal dormancy periods.
✖ Low Competitive Vigor: Restricted to bare rock.
HABITAT: Shaded Rock Fissures & Crevices · Micro-soil Pocket · Dry-Season Ψleaf ≈ -1.5 to -2.0 MPa
Maintains hydrated foliage; taps crevice moisture (Ψ ≈ -2.0 MPa).
Persistent electron transport under intense irradiance causes high ROS.
If soil water is exhausted, prone to fatal runaway xylem cavitation.
2. "THE GENOMIC BURDEN OF BEING EVERGREEN": MASSIVE EXPANSIONS
CAFE5 TURNOVER (λ = 0.0036): 86 Stringent Expansions + 22 Rate-Sensitive Expansions
Degradation of photo-damaged proteins via 26S proteasome.
Proteome surveillance under uninterrupted solar irradiance.
Continuous sensing of cell wall turgor and mechanical strain.
Constitutive defense of warm, hydrated foliage against fungi.
FOLIAR DEFENSE ARRAYS & SECONDARY METABOLIC SHIELDING
Massive expansion for dense cuticular wax biosynthesis & UV-B flavonoid screening.
Antioxidant conjugation & phenolic solubilization for sustained foliar defense.
Surveillance of opportunist foliar pathogens in permanently hydrated green tissue.
3. YEAR-ROUND PRODUCTIVITY & THE ECOLOGICAL CAVITATION RISK
of intermittent rains without reassembly cost.
to tolerate tissue desiccation (lethal at < -3 MPa).
✖ Foliar Pathogen Load: Permanent tissue target.
SYNOPTIC EVOLUTIONARY SYNTHESIS: POIKILOCHLOROPHYLLOUS ANHYDROBIOSIS VS. THE BURDEN OF BEING EVERGREEN
Bare monolithic quartzite outcrops (zero water buffer, Ψ < -100 MPa)
Shaded rock crevices & deep fissures (subsurface buffer, Ψ ≈ -2.0 MPa)
Poikilochlorophylly: Thylakoids dismantled into desiccoplasts; vitrification
Desiccation-Avoidance: Persistent green leaves, active stomata, ROS buffering
Streamlined (+194 net): TOC/TIC (+55), NDH (+29), 17 PPRs under selection
Genomic Burden (+723 net): F-box ligases (+51), LRR-RLKs (+57), NLRs (+22)
Absolute Desiccation Resilience (0% Mortality) | Lower annual carbon gain
High Competitive Carbon Gain (Amax) | High cavitation risk in mega-drought
